issues.issue: Endpoint text lists 'Week 2, Week 6, and Month 3 Visits' for the 6-month Study 304, borrowing Study 301's SAP quote (PP population baseline <25 mmHg); the cited endpoint does not clearly describe Study 304's actual endpoint timepoints.

The claim that mean IOP change was 'similar between groups' for baseline IOP <25 mmHg subjects (N=186/187) has no citation containing supporting numbers; only the >=25 group numbers (-4.1, -5.9, 1.8) are cited.
Result presents netarsudil as 'non-inferior to timolol' but the supporting table citation is explicitly labeled 'POST HOC ANALYSIS'; the post-hoc nature should be disclosed.
Automated flags for numbers 12, 18, 2017 are false positives — they are fragments of the approval date 12/18/2017 and should be excluded per date rules.
Automated flags for numbers 2, 28, 12, 18, 2017 are false positives — they are fragments of the dates 2/28/17 and 12/18/2017 and should be excluded per date rules.
